text:
anya: Heads-up — staging manifest mismatch on 3/8 nodes for the US-dedicated cabinets that arrived. Receiving flagged missing power harness and a packing list mismatch. tagging owners and asking for quick ownership + actions.

sam: Manifest and photos uploaded to the ticket: https://inbox.internal/INC-3421 — vendor says harness missing for rack-42. ETA 18:00 PT for delivery.

mike: Procurement confirms vendor will ship same-day but needs on-site eng to accept partial delivery. If harness missing we can still racked 5/8 nodes. Is partial activation acceptable? @olivia you own staging slots — decision?

olivia: I own EU slate cutover, not US, but I can coordinate. Prefer not to go live with partial power harnesses. Need to know customer reservations risk. Who will file the "accept partial" change request?

anya: @sam can you open a ticket (INC-3421 done) and add vendor contact + photos? I'll coordinate the test plan. Also need oncall for smoke validation once harness attached — @jack can you take that?

jack: I can do smoke after harness attach. What's the checklist to run? paste it here and I'll verify.

anya: ```
smoke checklist:
- verify kernel + driver (nvidia-smi)
- nv-host test suite (basic throughput)
- network egress to control plane + model registry
- KV cache persistence and latency check
- run small canary model (seq len 128) for 5 mins
- validate monitoring alerts & exporter metrics
```

sam: Ticket INC-3421 created and vendor on standby. PR for firewall rule to allow staging-controlplane created: https://github.com/redwood/provisioning/pull/1234 — @eng-infra please review. CI green but awaiting infra review.

mike: Note: ACME-Corp has 12 reserved slots for May 1 for Dedicated A. Sales flagged they need notice if we slip past EOD. @sales-ops — can you confirm required notice window?

sales-ops: They want 24h notice for anything that affects May 1. I'll prepare the notice template and hold until we know final ETA.

olivia: KMS keys for Private onboarding—are they provisioned for this rack/zone? If not, we can't onboard the reserved customers. @nina-security?

nina-security: KMS keys exist for that project but IAM role is missing in staging account. I'll add the role and attach to INC-3421. No key rotation impact.

jack: I'll run smoke at ~19:30 PT once harness attached and vendor confirms. Assigning myself on the ticket.

anya: Plan of record: 1) Sam confirms harness ETA + vendor engineer on site; 2) Mike confirms partial-accept fallback + whether we can spin subset nodes; 3) Jack runs smoke validation and posts logs; 4) Nina adds IAM role for KMS; 5) Olivia prepares reservation notice to customers; 6) escalate to infra-ops if no harness by 18:30 PT.

olivia: I'll draft the customer notice and ping CS now.

sam: :thumbsup: vendor engineer inbound, ETA 17:50 PT. updating INC-3421 with ETA and photos.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: PR provisioner/infra#1234 merged to staging (CI green).

anya: Thanks all — I'll post final status at 19:45 PT or earlier if resolved.
